name: n8n-create-instance-ai-eval

description: Authors a new Instance AI workflow eval case — written locally as JSON, calibrated against a real build, then pushed to the LangTracer suite CI runs — build cases, behaviour/process cases, credential cases, and seeded (mid-conversation) cases — with intent-driven expectations.
